verdict.rationale: Mem0 Open Source is explicitly documented as the same memory engine runnable on your own infrastructure via a Docker stack with REST API, dashboard, per-user API keys, and audit log, and this is corroborated by a runtime probe showing the pip package installs and imports without any API key. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on report of a full self-hosted deployment and more detail on production-scale self-hosted operations/support.
